about: TICKET-143 hand-labelled sample. 300 karaoke/playback-channel rows (channel title matches /karaok|playback/i, the same rule that seeded lib/karaoke-index/channels.json), drawn with a fixed seed (random.Random(143), at most 6 rows per channel) from the production search oracle captured 2026-10-02 (work/measurements/ticket-108/production-search-results.json, gitignored). Titles and channel titles are YouTube API Data (30-day retention): no videoIds, no other fields. Delete or re-derive this file by 2026-11-01. Labels were written by hand before the parser existed. Conventions: song drops version tags and bracketed subtitles; artist is the credited artist string as written, with any ft./feat. tail removed; null when the title names none; skipSongArtist marks rows whose song/artist the labeller could not determine (excluded from the song+artist denominator, still scored for kind).
